body: Meeting notetakers are increasingly deployed in settings where longitudinal context is available including calendar metadata, prior meetings, emails, slides, and speaker enrollments; however, meeting corpora remain limited in terms of size, domain coverage, and available context. We present OSynth, a large-scale synthetic dataset of simulated organizations comprising 570 hours of meeting audio together with associated artifacts and a latent ground-truth state. In a pairwise comparison, human raters distinguish OSynth meetings from real meeting transcripts with only 56% accuracy based on excerpts of 150-300 words. Across state-of-the-art LLMs, additional context yields significant gains on several entity-sensitive dimensions, demonstrating limitations of contemporary approaches and the potential usefulness of OSynth in developing better-contextualized meeting-understanding systems.
summaryZh: OSynth：对会议理解的纵向、上下文敏感的评估。会议记录员越来越多地部署在可提供纵向上下文的环境中，包括日历元数据、之前的会议、电子邮件、幻灯片和演讲者注册；然而，会议语料库在规模、领域覆盖范围和可用上下文方面仍然有限。我们展示了 OSynth，一个模拟组织的大规模综合数据集，包含 570 小时的会议音频以及相关的工件和潜在的真实状态。
